name: @airprompter/agent-runtime
description: Serve a verified AirPrompter agent release: slot resolution under the ramp and any retreat, rendered text with run references, provider wrappers, and the hosted-execution client. Renders and assigns over a bundle the customer loads with no store, daemon or network.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
